subject: Jinbe

intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Whale-shark fish-man, Fish-Man Karate/Jujutsu, water-particle shock and water throws, Armament and Observation. No Devil Fruit or invented transformation. Karate works on dry land through ambient/body water; Jujutsu water movement needs a bounded authored representation, no arbitrary target teleport. Helmsmanship alone is not magical ally range. Preserve measured displacement, armor pressure and reliable contact with actual named attacks. Targeted fresh research focus: Verify species specifically whale-shark fish-man, named Jinbe techniques including Karakusagawara Seiken and Soshark/Samegawara Seiken and their distinct mechanisms and manga-through-Wano uses. Separate Fish-Man Karate water-particle or body-water transmission/internal-force effects from Armament Haki and distinguish land-capable strikes from Fish-Man Jujutsu water throws that need an external water supply. Identify Kairagi as a defensive Armament technique rather than an attacking strike. Only include techniques actually used by Jinbe by Wano, not every Fish-Man Karate practitioner move, later traits, film-only moves or game attacks. Establish Armament and Observation evidence separately. Scope of six sources is species, complete character capability context, detailed Karate/Jujutsu attacks and official Wano corroboration in one fresh pipeline result. Facts do not substantiate game range, damage, armor-penetration values, displacement distance, targeting classes or water-resource rules. Record unsupported requests as gaps. No candidate or old generation supplied.
